head: WORKTREE
summary: Balance endpoint derives the balance from a SQL SUM over postings, applies the normal side in the domain, exact long conversion, 404/400/500 Problem Details, contract and Liquibase updated. Criteria proven by real-PostgreSQL ITs; no blocker or major found.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: 0002-create-transactions-and-postings.yaml (amount<>0 check, char(3), index on account_id, no balance column); AccountBalanceIT#noBalanceColumnExists; PostingPersistenceAdapterIT schema rejection tests

findings.description: Overflow on the SUM surfaces as ArithmeticException and thus a generic 500; Money.negate on Long.MIN_VALUE for credit-normal accounts does the same. Loud failure is as the brief asks, but the credit-normal negate edge is untested.
findings.suggestion: Optionally add a test for a net of Long.MIN_VALUE on a credit-normal account.

findings.description: Fixture hardcodes overdraft_policy ALLOWED for every account; fine for now but could be a parameter when UC2 needs it.
